da: At ingen kan tvinges til at afstå sin ejendom uden erstatning
At man ikke skal betale skat af ejendom
At man frit kan bygge overalt
en: That no one can be forced to give up their property without compensation
That you do not have to pay property tax
That the state owns all property

q.en: When did women get the right to vote in Denmark?

Et system hvor en enkelt person bestemmer
en: A system of government where the people influence decisions, typically through elections

q.en: What is a criminal record certificate?

en: A document showing whether a person has been convicted of a crime

q.da: Betyder en betinget fængselsstraf, at man kan undgå at komme i fængsel?
q.en: Does a suspended sentence mean you can avoid going to prison?

da: Nej, man kommer altid i fængsel
en: Yes, if you comply with the conditions
No, you always go to prison

q.da: Er der dødsstraf i Danmark?
q.en: Is there a death penalty in Denmark?

q.da: Skal man underrette politiet, før man holder en demonstration?
q.en: Must you notify the police before holding a demonstration?

q.da: Skal politiet normalt give tilladelse til, at man afholder en demonstration?
q.en: Must the police normally give permission to hold a demonstration?

da: Nej, men man skal give besked til politiet
en: No, but you must notify the police

q.da: Hvad er en byret?
q.en: What is a district court (byret)?

da: Den første instans i det danske retssystem
en: The first instance in the Danish court system

q.da: Hvad er en landsret?
q.en: What is a high court (landsret)?

da: En appellationsdomstol der behandler sager anket fra byretten
en: An appeals court that handles cases appealed from the district court

q.da: Hvad er Højesteret?
q.en: What is the Supreme Court (Højesteret)?

q.en: What is a lawyer (advokat)?

en: A legal advisor who can represent a person in court

q.en: Do you have the right to a defence lawyer if you are charged with a crime?

en: Only if you can afford it

q.da: Hvad er anklagemyndigheden?
q.en: What is the prosecution service?

da: Den myndighed der rejser tiltale mod forbrydere på statens vegne
en: The authority that prosecutes criminals on behalf of the state

q.da: Er man uskyldig indtil det modsatte er bevist i Danmark?
q.en: Are you innocent until proven otherwise in Denmark?

en: Yes, it is a fundamental legal principle

q.da: Hvad er et vidne i en retssag?
q.en: What is a witness in a court case?

en: A person who gives testimony about what they have seen or know

q.da: Hvad er en nævning?
q.en: What is a juror (nævning)?

da: En borger der deltager i afgørelsen af alvorlige straffesager
en: A citizen who participates in deciding serious criminal cases

q.da: Hvad er retshjælp?
q.en: What is legal aid?

en: Free or cheap legal advice for citizens

q.da: Hvad er forskellen på en civil sag og en straffesag?
q.en: What is the difference between a civil case and a criminal case?

en: A civil case is about disputes between citizens/companies; a criminal case is about offences

q.da: Hvad er en bøde?
q.en: What is a fine?

en: A financial penalty for a legal offence

q.da: Hvad er en betinget dom?
q.en: What is a suspended sentence?

da: En dom hvor straffen kun udføres, hvis den dømte begår ny kriminalitet
en: A sentence carried out only if the convicted person commits new crimes

q.da: Hvad er fogedrettens opgave?
q.en: What is the enforcement court's (fogedret) task?

da: At gennemtvinge domme og afgørelser, fx inddrivelse af gæld
en: To enforce judgments and decisions, e.g. debt collection

q.da: Er tortur forbudt i Danmark?
q.en: Is torture prohibited in Denmark?

q.da: Hvad er den europæiske menneskerettighedskonvention?
q.en: What is the European Convention on Human Rights?

da: En traktat der beskytter grundlæggende rettigheder som ytringsfrihed og forbud mod tortur
en: A treaty protecting fundamental rights such as freedom of expression and prohibition of torture

q.da: Hvad er domstolenes uafhængighed?
q.en: What is judicial independence?

da: At dommere træffer afgørelser uden påvirkning fra politikere eller andre
en: That judges make decisions without influence from politicians or others
That judges are elected by the people

q.da: Hvad sker der, hvis man ikke betaler en bøde?
q.en: What happens if you do not pay a fine?

da: Det kan ende med tvangsinddrivelse eller fængselsstraf
en: It can result in compulsory recovery or imprisonment

q.da: Hvad er en dommer?
q.en: What is a judge?

da: En juridisk embedsperson der afgør retssager
en: A legal official who decides court cases

q.da: Kan man klage over politiets adfærd i Danmark?
q.en: Can you complain about the police's conduct in Denmark?

da: Ja, man kan klage til Den Uafhængige Politiklagemyndighed
en: Yes, you can complain to the Independent Police Complaints Authority

q.da: Hvad er en varetægtsfængsling?
q.en: What is remand in custody?

da: Fængsling af en sigtet person inden retssagen
en: Imprisonment of a charged person before the trial

q.da: Hvor mange medlemmer har Folketinget?
q.en: How many members does Parliament have?

q.da: Hvem bestemmer, hvem der skal danne regering efter et valg?
q.en: Who decides who should form the government after an election?

da: Kongen/dronningen på baggrund af forhandlinger mellem partierne
en: The King/Queen based on negotiations between the parties

q.da: Hvem bestemmer, hvornår der skal udskrives valg til Folketinget?
q.en: Who decides when parliamentary elections should be called?

q.da: Har man pligt til at stemme til valg i Danmark?
q.en: Is there a duty to vote in Denmark?

q.da: Hvor ofte skal der ifølge grundloven afholdes folketingsvalg?
q.en: How often must parliamentary elections be held according to the constitution?

q.da: Hvad er Folketinget?
q.en: What is the Folketing?

q.da: Hvad er en regering?
q.en: What is a government?

da: De ministre der styrer landet under ledelse af statsministeren
en: The ministers who run the country under the leadership of the Prime Minister

q.da: Hvad er en statsminister?
q.en: What is a Prime Minister?

q.da: Hvad er en minister?
q.en: What is a minister?

da: Et regeringsmedlem der leder et bestemt politisk område
en: A government member who heads a specific policy area

q.da: Hvad er en mindretalsregering?
q.en: What is a minority government?

da: En regering der ikke har flertal i Folketinget alene
En regering med kun én minister
En regering kun for små partier
en: A government that does not have a majority in Parliament on its own
A government with only one minister
A government only for small parties

q.da: Er de fleste danske regeringer flertals- eller mindretalsregeringer?
q.en: Are most Danish governments majority or minority governments?

q.da: Hvad er et forlig?
q.en: What is a political agreement (forlig)?

da: En aftale mellem regeringen og et eller flere partier om et bestemt politisk emne
en: An agreement between the government and one or more parties on a specific policy issue

q.da: Hvad er et lovforslag?
q.en: What is a bill (lovforslag)?

da: Et udkast til en ny lov der fremlægges i Folketinget
en: A draft of a new law presented in Parliament

q.da: Hvem kan fremsætte lovforslag?
q.en: Who can propose bills?

en: Members of Parliament and the government

q.da: Hvad er Folketingets åbning?
q.en: What is the opening of Parliament?

da: Den årlige ceremoni i oktober, hvor statsministeren holder en tale og det politiske år begynder
en: The annual ceremony in October when the PM gives a speech and the political year begins

q.da: Hvad er et folketingsudvalg?
q.en: What is a parliamentary committee?

da: En mindre gruppe folketingsmedlemmer der behandler lovforslag inden for et bestemt område
en: A smaller group of MPs that examines bills within a specific area

q.da: Hvad er et mistillidsvotum?
q.en: What is a vote of no confidence?

da: Et forslag i Folketinget om at regeringen eller en minister skal gå af
en: A proposal in Parliament that the government or a minister must resign

q.da: Hvad sker der, hvis Folketinget vedtager et mistillidsvotum mod regeringen?
q.en: What happens if Parliament passes a vote of no confidence against the government?

q.da: Hvad er et ministerium?
q.en: What is a ministry?

da: En statslig organisation der ledes af en minister
en: A state organisation led by a minister

q.da: Hvad er en embedsmand?
q.en: What is a civil servant (embedsmand)?

da: En offentligt ansat der rådgiver og betjener ministeren
en: A publicly employed person who advises and serves the minister

q.da: Hvad er oppositionspartier?
q.en: What are opposition parties?

da: Partier der ikke er en del af regeringen
en: Parties that are not part of the government

q.da: Hvad er Statsrådet?
q.en: What is the Council of State (Statsrådet)?

da: Et møde mellem kongen/dronningen og regeringens ministre, hvor love underskrives
en: A meeting between the King/Queen and government ministers where laws are signed

q.da: Hvad er parlamentarisme?
q.en: What is parliamentarism?

da: Et princip om at regeringen skal have Folketingets tillid for at regere
en: A principle that the government must have Parliament's confidence to govern
That the people vote on everything

q.da: Hvornår blev parlamentarismen indført i Danmark?
q.en: When was parliamentarism introduced in Denmark?

q.da: Hvad er Christiansborg?
q.en: What is Christiansborg?

da: Folketingets og regeringens hovedbygning i København
en: The main building of Parliament and the government in Copenhagen
A castle only for the king

q.da: Kan man følge Folketingets debatter?

da: Ja, de er offentlige og kan følges på tv og internettet

q.en: Which body normally runs the public kindergartens and nurseries?

q.en: Which of the following areas are the municipalities responsible for?

en: A local authority handling tasks such as schools, elderly care and childcare

q.en: What is a municipal council?

da: Et folkevalgt organ der træffer beslutninger i kommunen
en: An elected body that makes decisions in the municipality

da: En administrativ enhed der primært er ansvarlig for sundhed og sygehuse
en: An administrative unit primarily responsible for health and hospitals

q.da: Hvad er et regionsråd?
q.en: What is a regional council?

da: Et folkevalgt organ der leder regionen
en: An elected body that leads the region

q.en: Can you vote in municipal elections without being a Danish citizen?

da: Ja, hvis man har fast bopæl i Danmark og opfylder visse krav
en: Yes, if you have a permanent address in Denmark and meet certain requirements

q.en: What is municipal tax?

da: En skat man betaler til sin kommune
en: A tax you pay to your municipality

q.da: Er kommunalskatten ens i hele Danmark?
q.en: Is municipal tax the same throughout Denmark?

da: Nej, den varierer fra kommune til kommune
en: No, it varies from municipality to municipality

q.en: What is a mayor?

da: Den politiske leder af en kommune, valgt af kommunalbestyrelsen
en: The political leader of a municipality, elected by the municipal council

q.da: Hvad er kommunens ansvar for ældre?
q.en: What is the municipality's responsibility for the elderly?

en: Elderly care, care homes and home help

q.da: Hvad er en lokalplan?
q.en: What is a local plan?

da: En plan der bestemmer, hvad et bestemt område i kommunen må bruges til
en: A plan that determines what a specific area in the municipality may be used for

q.en: Who finances the folkeskoler?

q.da: Kan borgere deltage i kommunalbestyrelsens møder?
q.en: Can citizens attend municipal council meetings?

q.da: Hvad er en regionsformand?
q.en: What is a regional chair?

da: Den politiske leder af en region
en: The political leader of a region

q.da: Hvad er jobcentre?
q.en: What are job centres?

da: Kommunale centre der hjælper borgere med at finde arbejde
en: Municipal centres that help citizens find work

q.da: Hvem har ansvaret for den offentlige transport i regionerne?
q.en: Who is responsible for public transport in the regions?

en: The regions in cooperation with the municipalities

q.en: What is a municipal merger?

da: At to eller flere kommuner slås sammen til én
en: When two or more municipalities are combined into one

q.en: What do the regions primarily finance?

q.en: What are the five regions of Denmark called?

da: Hovedstaden, Midtjylland, Nordjylland, Sjælland og Syddanmark
Øst, Vest, Nord, Syd og Midt
København, Aarhus, Odense, Aalborg og Esbjerg
en: Capital, Central Jutland, North Jutland, Zealand and Southern Denmark
East, West, North, South and Central
Copenhagen, Aarhus, Odense, Aalborg and Esbjerg

en: Municipalities have more tasks (school, elderly care, etc.); regions focus primarily on health
